- **Fixed the black screen after the splash** on a fresh install of the remote
  app. The first-run setup (and the device and server screens) now show up
  properly. If you installed 0.2.0 or 0.2.1, update to this version.
- **Relay server image renamed** to `ghcr.io/sandoramix/slop-remote-relay-server`,
  published with the version tag and `latest`. The old `relay-server` name is
  no longer updated.
